draftNotice.en: DRAFT. Not yet clinically approved. Call 999 or 112 first.
draftNotice.sw: DRAFTI. Haijaidhinishwa na wataalamu wa afya. Piga 999 au 112 kwanza.

text.en: Is the person responding when you tap their shoulders and shout?
text.sw: Je, mtu anaitikia ukimgusa mabegani na kupiga kelele?

text.en: Is the person choking or unable to speak?

banner.en: Call 999 or 112 now. Put your phone on speaker.
banner.sw: Piga 999 au 112 sasa. Weka simu kwenye spika.

b.en: Check for danger around you. Do not put yourself at risk.
b.sw: Angalia hatari karibu nawe. Usijiweke hatarini.

b.en: Tap their shoulders firmly and shout. If they do not respond and are not breathing normally, start CPR. Gasping is not normal breathing.
b.sw: Gusa mabega yake kwa nguvu na upige kelele. Asipoitikia na hapumui kawaida, anza CPR. Kuhema kwa shida si kupumua kawaida.

b.en: Call 999 or 112, or ask someone nearby to call. Send someone to find a defibrillator (AED) if one is close.
b.sw: Piga 999 au 112, au mwombe mtu aliye karibu apige. Mtume mtu atafute mashine ya AED ikiwa ipo karibu.

b.en: Lay them on their back on a firm surface. Kneel beside their chest.
b.sw: Mlaze chali kwenye sehemu ngumu. Piga magoti kando ya kifua chake.

b.en: Put the heel of one hand on the centre of the chest, the other hand on top. Push down about 5 to 6 cm, 100 to 120 times a minute. Let the chest rise fully each time. Follow the pulse on screen.
b.sw: Weka kiganja katikati ya kifua, mkono mwingine juu yake. Bonyeza chini kama sentimita 5 hadi 6, mara 100 hadi 120 kwa dakika. Acha kifua kirudi juu kabisa kila mara. Fuata mdundo ulio kwenye skrini.

b.en: Do not stop until help takes over, they start breathing normally, or you cannot continue. If an AED arrives, switch it on and follow its voice. If someone else can help, swap every 2 minutes.
b.sw: Usisimame hadi wahudumu wachukue nafasi, aanze kupumua kawaida, au ushindwe kuendelea. AED ikifika, iwashe na ufuate sauti yake. Ikiwa kuna mtu mwingine, badilishane kila dakika 2.

warning.en: This guide is for adults. Children and babies need different steps.
warning.sw: Mwongozo huu ni wa watu wazima. Watoto na watoto wachanga wanahitaji hatua tofauti.

sources: ERC Guidelines 2025 (Basic Life Support, First Aid)
IFRC/ICRC International First Aid, Resuscitation and Education Guidelines
guides.reviewNote: Verified from published summaries: call before checking breathing, 100-120/min, 5-6 cm, compression-only for untrained rescuers (ERC 2025). Reviewer to confirm wording and whether to add rescue breaths for trained people.

title.sw: Mtu mzima au mtoto mkubwa anakabwa

banner.en: If they cannot breathe, cough or speak, act now and call 999 or 112.
banner.sw: Asipoweza kupumua, kukohoa au kuongea, chukua hatua sasa na upige 999 au 112.

b.en: If they can cough, speak or breathe, encourage them to keep coughing. Do not hit their back yet.
b.sw: Wakiweza kukohoa, kuongea au kupumua, wahimize waendelee kukohoa. Usipige mgongo bado.

b.en: Lean them forward. Give up to 5 firm blows between the shoulder blades with the heel of your hand.
b.sw: Mwinamishe mbele. Mpige hadi mara 5 kwa nguvu kati ya mabega kwa kiganja chako.

b.en: Stand behind them. Make a fist just above the belly button, hold it with your other hand, and pull sharply inwards and upwards, up to 5 times.
b.sw: Simama nyuma yake. Funga ngumi juu kidogo ya kitovu, ishike kwa mkono mwingine, na vuta kwa kasi kuelekea ndani na juu, hadi mara 5.

b.en: Alternate 5 back blows and 5 abdominal thrusts until the object comes out or the person stops responding.
b.sw: Badilishana mapigo 5 ya mgongoni na mivuto 5 ya tumboni hadi kitu kitoke au mtu aache kuitikia.

b.en: Lay them on the ground and start CPR straight away. See the CPR guide.
b.sw: Mlaze chini na uanze CPR mara moja. Tazama mwongozo wa CPR.

sources: AHA 2025 Guidelines update (adults and conscious children: alternate 5 back blows and 5 abdominal thrusts)
guides.reviewNote: Sequence verified against the AHA 2025 summary. Reviewer to decide advice for pregnant or very large people (chest thrusts).

banner.en: Call 999 or 112 now. Heavy bleeding can be life-threatening.
banner.sw: Piga 999 au 112 sasa. Kutoka damu nyingi kunaweza kuhatarisha maisha.

b.en: If you can, cover your hand with a glove or a clean plastic bag. Do not delay pressing on the wound.
b.sw: Ukiweza, funika mkono wako kwa glavu au mfuko safi wa plastiki. Usichelewe kubonyeza jeraha.

b.en: Press firmly with a clean cloth, or your hand, directly on the wound. Keep pressing. Do not lift it to look.
b.sw: Bonyeza kwa nguvu kwa kitambaa safi, au mkono wako, moja kwa moja kwenye jeraha. Endelea kubonyeza. Usiinue kuangalia.

b.en: If blood soaks through, put more cloth on top and keep pressing.
b.sw: Damu ikilowesha, weka kitambaa kingine juu na uendelee kubonyeza.

t.en: Lay them down and keep warm

b.en: Lay the person down. Cover them with a blanket or coat. Do not give food or drink.
b.sw: Mlaze mtu chini. Mfunike kwa blanketi au koti. Usimpe chakula wala kinywaji.

b.en: Bind firmly with a bandage or strip of cloth. It should be firm but not so tight that fingers or toes turn pale or cold.
b.sw: Funga kwa nguvu kwa bandeji au kipande cha kitambaa. Iwe imara lakini isibane hadi vidole vipate weupe au baridi.

donts.en: Do not pull out anything stuck in the wound. Press around it.
donts.sw: Usitoe kitu kilichokwama kwenye jeraha. Bonyeza kuzunguka.

guides.reviewNote: Tourniquet use by lay people intentionally NOT included; reviewer to decide (ERC 2025 mentions tourniquets as a simple intervention).

banner.en: Call 999 or 112 for large burns, burns on the face, hands or genitals, chemical or electrical burns, or any burn on a child.
banner.sw: Piga 999 au 112 kwa kuungua kukubwa, usoni, mikononi au sehemu za siri, kuungua kwa kemikali au umeme, au mtoto yeyote.

b.en: Move away from the heat. If clothes are on fire: stop, drop to the ground and roll. Remove wet or smouldering clothing unless it is stuck to the skin.
b.sw: Ondoka kwenye joto. Nguo ikiwaka: simama, lala chini na ujiviringishe. Vua nguo zilizolowa au zinazofuka isipokuwa zimeganda kwenye ngozi.

b.en: Hold under cool running water for 20 minutes. Do not use ice.
b.sw: Weka chini ya maji baridi yanayotiririka kwa dakika 20. Usitumie barafu.

b.en: Remove jewellery near the burn before it swells, but not anything stuck to the skin.
b.sw: Ondoa vito karibu na pahali palipoungua kabla ya kuvimba, lakini si kitu kilichoganda kwenye ngozi.

b.en: Cover with cling film or a clean, non-fluffy cloth. Do not wrap tightly.
b.sw: Funika kwa karatasi ya kufunga chakula au kitambaa safi kisicho na manyoya. Usifunge kwa kubana.

b.en: Keep the rest of the body warm and stay with them until help arrives.
b.sw: Weka sehemu nyingine ya mwili joto na ubaki naye hadi msaada ufike.

donts.en: Do not put butter, oil, toothpaste or ointment on a burn. Do not burst blisters.
donts.sw: Usipake siagi, mafuta, dawa ya meno au marhamu kwenye pahali palipoungua. Usipasue malengelenge.

sources: IFRC/ICRC guidelines (cool burns with running water)
guides.reviewNote: Reviewer to confirm 20-minute cooling and the referral criteria in the banner.

banner.en: Call 999 or 112 now. The person must reach a hospital with antivenom as fast as possible.
banner.sw: Piga 999 au 112 sasa. Mgonjwa afike hospitali yenye dawa ya sumu ya nyoka haraka iwezekanavyo.

b.en: Get the person out of reach. Do not try to catch or kill the snake.
b.sw: Mwondoe mtu mbali. Usijaribu kumkamata au kumuua nyoka.

b.en: Make them sit or lie down. Movement spreads venom faster. Reassure them.
b.sw: Mkalishe au mlaze. Kutembea kunasambaza sumu haraka. Mtuliza.

b.en: Take off rings, watches and tight clothing near the bite before it swells.
b.sw: Ondoa pete, saa na nguo zinazobana karibu na pale alipoumwa kabla ya kuvimba.

b.en: Rest the bitten limb and support it like a broken limb. Keep it at about heart level.
b.sw: Pumzisha kiungo kilichoumwa na kisaidie kama kiungo kilichovunjika. Kiweke usawa wa moyo.

b.en: Note the time of the bite and what the snake looked like, if you saw it. Mark the edge of any swelling with a pen if you can.
b.sw: Kumbuka muda wa kuumwa na umbo la nyoka ukimwona. Weka alama ya kalamu mwisho wa uvimbe ukiweza.

donts.en: Do not cut the bite, suck the venom, tie a tight band, apply ice, or use herbs, stones or alcohol.
donts.sw: Usikate pale, usinyonye sumu, usifunge kamba kwa kubana, usiweke barafu, wala usitumie mitishamba, mawe au pombe.

sources: WHO snakebite first-aid guidance (immobilise; avoid cutting, suction and tight tourniquets)
guides.reviewNote: Reviewer to confirm against current Kenya MoH snakebite guidance.

banner.en: Call 999 or 112 if it lasts more than 5 minutes, repeats, it is their first seizure, they are injured, pregnant or in water.
banner.sw: Piga 999 au 112 ikizidi dakika 5, ikirudia, ni mara ya kwanza, amejeruhiwa, ana mimba au yuko majini.

b.en: Move hard or sharp objects away. Note the time the seizure started.
b.sw: Ondoa vitu vigumu au vikali. Kumbuka muda ulipoanza.

b.en: Put something soft under their head. Loosen tight clothing around the neck.
b.sw: Weka kitu laini chini ya kichwa. Legeza nguo shingoni.

b.en: Do not restrain them and do not put anything in their mouth.
b.sw: Usimshike kwa nguvu na usiweke kitu mdomoni.

b.en: Roll them onto their side (recovery position). Stay with them and speak calmly until they are fully awake.
b.sw: Mgeuze ubavuni (nafasi ya kupona). Baki naye na uongee kwa utulivu hadi aamke kabisa.

guides.reviewNote: Reviewer to confirm the 5-minute threshold and add infant febrile seizure advice if wanted.

banner.en: Call 999 or 112 now. Put your phone on speaker.
banner.sw: Piga 999 au 112 sasa. Weka simu kwenye spika.

b.en: Tilt the head back gently and lift the chin. Look, listen and feel for normal breathing for up to 10 seconds.
b.sw: Inamisha kichwa nyuma kwa upole na inua kidevu. Tazama, sikiliza na hisi kupumua kawaida kwa hadi sekunde 10.

b.en: Start CPR. See the CPR guide.
b.sw: Anza CPR. Tazama mwongozo wa CPR.

t.en: If breathing: roll onto the side

b.en: Kneel beside them. Bring the nearer arm up, place the far hand against their cheek, bend the far knee, and roll them towards you.
b.sw: Piga magoti kando yake. Inua mkono ulio karibu nawe, weka kiganja cha upande wa mbali shavuni, kunja goti la mbali, na umgeuze kuelekea kwako.

b.en: Tilt the head back slightly so the mouth faces downwards. Stay with them and check breathing often.
b.sw: Inamisha kichwa nyuma kidogo ili mdomo uelekee chini. Baki naye na uangalie kupumua mara kwa mara.

warning.en: If you suspect a neck or spine injury, move them only if breathing is at risk.
warning.sw: Ukishuku jeraha la shingo au uti wa mgongo, msogeze tu ikiwa kupumua kuko hatarini.

guides.reviewNote: Reviewer to confirm wording for suspected spinal injury.

banner.en: Call 999 or 112 immediately. Every minute matters.
banner.sw: Piga 999 au 112 mara moja. Kila dakika ni muhimu.

b.en: Face: is one side drooping? Arms: can they raise both? Speech: slurred or confused? Time: if any sign, call now.
b.sw: Uso: upande mmoja umeinama? Mikono: anaweza kuinua yote miwili? Usemi: unakwama au amechanganyikiwa? Muda: dalili yoyote, piga simu sasa.

b.en: Note when the signs started. Tell the responders.
b.sw: Kumbuka muda dalili zilipoanza. Waambie wahudumu.

b.en: Sit or lie them down safely. Do not give food, drink or medicine.
b.sw: Mkalishe au mlaze salama. Usimpe chakula, kinywaji au dawa.

banner.en: Call 999 or 112 now. Put your phone on speaker.
banner.sw: Piga 999 au 112 sasa. Weka simu kwenye spika.

b.en: Park safely, switch on hazard lights, stay out of traffic. Do not stand between vehicles.
b.sw: Egesha gari salama, washa taa za hatari, kaa mbali na magari. Usisimame kati ya magari.

b.en: Move them only if there is fire or immediate danger. Keep the head and neck still.
b.sw: Wahamishe tu kukiwa na moto au hatari ya papo hapo. Weka kichwa na shingo vitulie.

b.en: If not breathing normally, start CPR. If bleeding heavily, press hard on the wound.
b.sw: Asipopumua kawaida, anza CPR. Akivuja damu nyingi, bonyeza jeraha kwa nguvu.

b.en: Do not remove a motorcyclist's helmet unless it blocks breathing.
b.sw: Usivue kofia ngumu ya mwendesha pikipiki isipokuwa inazuia kupumua.

b.en: Cover them and keep talking calmly until help arrives.
b.sw: Mfunike na uendelee kuongea naye kwa utulivu hadi msaada ufike.

banner.en: Get out, stay out, call 999 or 112.

b.en: Leave immediately. Do not collect belongings. Stay low if there is smoke.
b.sw: Ondoka mara moja. Usichukue mali. Kaa chini kama kuna moshi.

b.en: Closing doors slows the fire and smoke.
b.sw: Kufunga milango kunapunguza kasi ya moto na moshi.

b.en: If a door is hot, do not open it. Use another way out or signal from a window.
b.sw: Mlango ukiwa moto, usiufungue. Tumia njia nyingine au toa ishara dirishani.

b.en: Do not go back inside for people or pets. Tell the fire crew who may still be inside.
b.sw: Usirudi ndani kwa watu au wanyama. Waambie zima moto nani yuko ndani.

b.en: Stop, drop and roll. Cool burns with running water for 20 minutes. See the Burns guide.
b.sw: Simama, lala chini na ujiviringishe. Poza kwa maji yanayotiririka dakika 20. Tazama mwongozo wa Kuungua.

sources: Kenya fire service public guidance (reviewer to attach)
guides.reviewNote: Reviewer to attach an official Kenyan fire-safety source.

banner.en: If you can speak safely, call 999 or 112. If you cannot, stay quiet. Your alert is already sent.
banner.sw: Ukiweza kuongea salama, piga 999 au 112. Usipoweza, kaa kimya. Ombi lako limeshatumwa.

b.en: Move away from the danger to a place with a lock or many people, if you can do so safely.
b.sw: Ondoka kwenye hatari uende mahali penye kufuli au watu wengi, ikiwa ni salama.

b.en: Do not argue, chase or fight. Property can be replaced.
b.sw: Usibishane, usifukuze wala usipigane. Mali inaweza kurudishwa.

t.en: Keep quiet and keep your phone silent
t.sw: Kaa kimya na zima sauti ya simu

b.en: Silence your phone. Keep your location sharing on so responders can find you.
b.sw: Zima sauti ya simu. Endelea kushiriki mahali ulipo ili wahudumu wakupate.

t.en: Help the injured only when safe

b.en: If someone is bleeding and it is safe, press hard on the wound. See the Heavy bleeding guide.
b.sw: Mtu akivuja damu na ni salama, bonyeza jeraha kwa nguvu. Tazama mwongozo wa Kutoka damu nyingi.

sources: Reviewer to attach official Kenyan public safety guidance
guides.reviewNote: This is safety guidance, not clinical first aid. Reviewer (and police liaison if available) to confirm.

title.en: If you or someone has been sexually assaulted
title.sw: Ikiwa wewe au mtu amebakwa au kunyanyaswa kingono

banner.en: You are not to blame. Help is available. You decide what happens next.
banner.sw: Wewe huna kosa. Msaada upo. Wewe ndiye unayeamua hatua inayofuata.

b.en: What happened is not your fault. You do not have to speak to anyone you do not want to.
b.sw: Kilichotokea si kosa lako. Huhitaji kuongea na mtu usiyemtaka.

b.en: If you can, go somewhere you feel safe, with someone you trust.
b.sw: Ukiweza, nenda mahali unapojisikia salama, na mtu unayemwamini.

t.sw: Nenda kupata huduma ya afya mapema

b.en: Health workers can treat injuries and give medicines that help prevent HIV and pregnancy. They work best the sooner you go, ideally within 72 hours. You can still go if more time has passed.
b.sw: Wahudumu wa afya wanaweza kutibu majeraha na kutoa dawa za kusaidia kuzuia VVU na mimba. Zinafanya kazi vizuri ukienda mapema, ikiwezekana ndani ya saa 72. Unaweza kwenda hata ikiwa muda umepita.

b.en: If possible, avoid washing and keep the clothes you wore in a paper bag. You can still get care and report if you have already washed. Your health comes first.
b.sw: Ikiwezekana, usioge na uhifadhi nguo ulizovaa kwenye mfuko wa karatasi. Bado unaweza kupata huduma na kuripoti ukishaoga. Afya yako ndiyo kipaumbele.

b.en: Kenya's national gender-based violence helpline is free. Call 1195 to talk to someone and be linked to services.
b.sw: Nambari ya taifa ya unyanyasaji wa kijinsia ni ya bure. Piga 1195 uongee na mtu na uunganishwe na huduma.

sources: Kenya MoH National Guidelines on Management of Sexual Violence (3rd ed., 2014)
WHO clinical guidance on responding to sexual violence
National GBV helpline 1195 (State Department for Gender / UN Women)
guides.reviewNote: SENSITIVE. Reviewer must check the time windows (HIV prevention within 72 h; emergency contraception window) against the current Kenya MoH guideline and have a GBV counsellor review the tone. Never log the content a person views.

title.sw: Mtu aliye katika dhiki ya kihisia

banner.en: If someone is in immediate danger, call 999 or 112. You can also call the Kenya Red Cross on 1199.
banner.sw: Mtu akiwa hatarini sasa, piga 999 au 112. Unaweza pia kupiga Kenya Red Cross 1199.

b.en: Check for danger. If they may hurt themselves, stay with them and do not leave them alone.
b.sw: Angalia hatari. Akiweza kujidhuru, baki naye na usimwache peke yake.

b.en: Give them time. Do not rush to fix things or say 'calm down'. Let them speak.
b.sw: Mpe muda. Usikimbilie kutatua mambo wala kusema 'tulia'. Mruhusu aseme.

b.en: If they say they want to die, ask kindly and clearly if they are thinking of ending their life. Asking does not put the idea in their mind.
b.sw: Akisema anataka kufa, muulize kwa upole na wazi kama anafikiria kujiua. Kuuliza hakumwekei wazo.

b.en: If it is safe, help move anything they could use to harm themselves out of reach.
b.sw: Ikiwa ni salama, saidia kuondoa kitu chochote anachoweza kutumia kujidhuru.

b.en: Stay until help arrives. Help them contact a trusted person or call 1199.
b.sw: Baki hadi msaada ufike. Msaidie kuwasiliana na mtu anayemwamini au apige 1199.

sources: WHO Psychological First Aid: Guide for field workers (Look, Listen, Link)
WHO mhGAP guidance on self-harm and suicide
guides.reviewNote: SENSITIVE. Reviewer (mental-health professional) to confirm wording and to verify the 1199 line and add any other verified Kenyan crisis line.
Depth, breaths and ratios differ from adults; needs clinician-authored steps.
Sources differ on chest-thrust technique for infants (heel of hand vs two fingers). Clinician must decide.
AHA 2025 added an opioid overdose algorithm; local naloxone availability must be reviewed.
Inhaler dosing must be set by clinician.
